nl.title: WordPress multisite in DirectAdmin
nl.excerpt: WordPress multisite op DirectAdmin: subdomains/subdirs, DNS wildcards en Installatron-keuzes.
nl.bodyHtml:
Multisite deelt één WP-core voor meerdere sites — planning van URL-modus en DNS is cruciaal.

Voorbereiding

  • Lege installatie of bewuste conversie
  • DNS-wildcard bij subdomains

Stappen

  1. Bepaal subdomains vs. subdirectories
  2. Installeer WP (Installatron) op root
  3. Volg WP Netwerk-setup / of Installatron multisite-optie
  4. Zet wildcard DNS bij subdomain-modus
  5. Configureer SSL (wildcard of per host)

Controleren

  • Tweede site bereikbaar
  • Supersite admin werkt

Tip: Multisite is complexer in backups/restore — documenteer.

Let op: Shared hosting limieten kunnen netwerken beperken.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: subdomain; letsencrypt-da.

This guide covers WordPress multisite in DirectAdmin. You work in WordPress (wp-admin), focusing on WordPress, multisite, DirectAdmin — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to WordPress (wp-admin)
  • Focus of this article: WordPress, multisite, DirectAdmin
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Open WordPress (wp-admin) and look specifically for settings around WordPress, multisite, DirectAdmin.
  2. Take a backup (Installatron or panel) before changing WordPress.
  3. Sign in to /wp-admin and open Plugins, Themes, Settings, Media or WooCommerce — whatever fits multisite.
  4. Apply the change; on a critical error isolate via File Manager (rename plugins).
  5. Clear caches and test the pages that touch DirectAdmin.
  6. Document what you changed around WordPress, multisite, DirectAdmin (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for WordPress, multisite, DirectAdmin matches “WordPress multisite in DirectAdmin”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside WordPress multisite DirectAdmin
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get WordPress, multisite, DirectAdmin right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if WordPress, multisite, DirectAdmin touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
